display_name: Pi web developer (React/Next.js, headless Chromium via agent-browser)
notes: general-dev + agent-browser driving Playwright's Chromium (Chrome for Testing has no linux-arm64 build).
The agent serves the app on localhost inside the sandbox and checks it with agent-browser; no egress is needed for that. Use localhost, not 127.0.0.1 (IPv4 loopback is swallowed in OpenShell).
googlefonts provider: next/font/google needs it for next build (dev falls back without it).
A host-installed node_modules (macOS) lacks linux native binaries; the agent runs npm install in the sandbox, after which the host needs its own fresh npm install.
